# Zehn: full fact sheet

Updated 2026-11-26. Short version: https://thezehnapp.com/llms.txt

Zehn (pronounced “Zen”) is a book summary app for iPhone and Android. It turns nonfiction books into short audio and text summaries with synced text, and every book has Ask AI, a chat that answers questions about that book. It is built for readers beyond English: summaries are in English, Russian, Arabic, Tajik, Hindi and Urdu. Zehn also has an everyday AI chat with Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and Grok (yearly plan).

## Key facts

- Name: Zehn (pronounced “Zen”)
- What it is: Book summary app: audio and text summaries of nonfiction books
- Made by: Zehn by Safari Group (founded 2005, Dubai); founder Muhammad Safarzoda
- Arabic narration: Modern Standard Arabic (fusha)
- Contact: contact@safarigrp.com
- Platforms: iPhone (App Store) and Android (Google Play)
- Library: 10,000+ books
- Readers: 50,000+
- Formats: Audio with synced text, and text
- Ask AI: A chat on every book that answers questions about that book, in the reader's language
- General AI chat: An everyday AI chat for any question, with Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and Grok (yearly plan), and AI personas such as Business Mentor, Language Tutor, Psychologist and Money Coach
- Book Club: Topic clubs where readers post, reply in comments, take challenges and see a leaderboard
- Summary length: 15–20 min a book
- Free plan: 1 free book a day, forever (no AI features)
- Zehn Pro monthly: $9.99 a month: unlimited books, offline listening, Ask AI, AI chat with 1 model
- Zehn Pro yearly: $36 a year with a 7-day free trial: unlimited books, offline listening, Ask AI, AI chat with Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and Grok
- Languages: English, Russian, Arabic, Tajik, Hindi, Urdu
- Website: thezehnapp.com

## Plans

- Free forever: 1 free book a day. No AI features.
- Zehn Pro monthly, $9.99 a month: unlimited books, offline listening, Ask AI, the everyday AI chat with 1 model.
- Zehn Pro yearly, $36 a year with a 7-day free trial: unlimited books, offline listening, Ask AI, the everyday AI chat with Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and Grok (yearly plan).
- Regional pricing in 30+ countries.

## Features

- Summaries: nonfiction books as audio with synced text, and as text, 15–20 minutes a book.
- Ask AI: a chat inside every book that answers questions about that book, in the reader's language.
- AI Chat tab: an everyday AI chat with a model picker (Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok on the yearly plan) and AI personas: Business Mentor, Money Coach, Productivity Coach, Mindfulness Guide, Psychologist, Negotiator, Language Tutor, Leadership Mentor, Science Explainer.
- Book Club tab: topic clubs (for example Calm Club) where readers post their thoughts, reply in comments, take challenges and see a leaderboard.
- Library, streaks and daily goals, offline listening on Pro.
